scenes.text: The easiest bedtime rule in the house: the Wi-Fi goes to sleep too.

scenes.title: Open your router's app.
scenes.body: Look for **"schedule" or "parental controls."** Names vary.

scenes.title: Remember mobile data.
scenes.body: A router schedule **doesn't cover it.** Set bedtime on the phone itself too.

scenes.sub: Including how to cover mobile data too.
